checks: 2 independent Node logic tests and 5 extended browser tests
Responsive widths 320/375/768/1440; clipboard and download mocked
Real Chromium task editing, opt-in storage, restore, denial/quota and validated file import/export tested separately; storage APIs simulated.

logic.scope: Deterministic inline JavaScript logic, executed in Node with explicit fixtures.

browser.scope: Real Chromium DOM; clipboard/download APIs simulated; external HTTP(S) blocked.

limitations: Local headless Chromium; no Safari, Firefox, physical-device, native clipboard, screen-reader or full accessibility certification.
Hosting and existing Tailwind CDN can receive network requests; user inputs are processed locally.
No public deployment or publication has been verified.
